title: Latent JEPA: Abstract Future Prediction for Latent Reasoning in Chemistry
abstract: arXiv:2610.01947v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models offer a promising foundation for chemical reasoning, bringing together chemical knowledge and multistep problem solving. Chemical intuition can provide an initial sense of plausible outcomes before the details of a solution are fully worked out. Inspired by how such expectations complement explicit analysis, we study how continuous latent thoughts can be trained to anticipate informative aspects of future solutions without verbalizing every intermediate step. We introduce Latent JEPA, a framework that combines autoregressive learning with joint-embedding prediction of one or more future views. For chemical reasoning, we develop textual and molecular prediction objectives that connect latent thoughts to both subsequent reasoning and molecular outcomes. translated_title: 潜在JEPA：面向化学潜在推理的抽象未来预测
translated_abstract: 大语言模型为化学推理提供了有前景的基础，将化学知识与多步骤问题求解结合在一起。化学直觉能够在求解细节被完全推演出来之前，就对可能的结果形成初步感知。受这种“预期”如何补充显式分析的启发，我们研究了如何训练连续的潜在思维（latent thoughts）来预测未来解答中富含信息的部分，而无需将每个中间步骤都用语言显式地表达出来。我们提出了Latent JEPA，这是一个将自回归学习与对一个或多个未来视角的联合嵌入预测相结合的框架。针对化学推理任务，我们设计了文本层面和分子层面的预测目标，将潜在思维与后续推理过程以及分子结果联系起来。在ChemCoTBench上的实验表明，该方法在分子优化以及若干分子编辑和反应指标上均取得了提升。表征分析显示，未来预测使得模型……
tldr: 提出Latent JEPA框架，将自回归学习与对未来视角的联合嵌入预测相结合，训练连续潜在思维在不显式表达中间步骤的情况下预测后续推理与分子结果，从而在ChemCoTBench上的分子优化、分子编辑和反应任务中取得性能提升。
en_tdlr: Latent JEPA combines autoregressive learning with joint-embedding prediction of future views, training continuous latent thoughts to anticipate future reasoning and molecular outcomes without verbalizing intermediate steps, yielding gains in molecular optimization, editing, and reaction tasks on ChemCoTBench.
